name: My neighbor's panties
source:
Your grandfather leaves you his boarding house before disappearing on an endless vacation. Fill the empty rooms, build relationships with your new neighbors, explore the city, and shape your own college life...

[From [url=https://vulgar-frog.itch.io/my-neighbors-panties]itch.io[/url]]

你的祖父在无尽的假期中消失之前，把他的寄宿处留给了你。填补空房间，与新邻居建立关系，探索城市，塑造你自己的大学生活……
